metadata.title_zh: 多維度 OKR 對齊評分系統

content.title_zh: 多維度 OKR 對齊評分系統
content.subtitle: Patent Disclosure VS-OKR-2026-001

slides.speaker_notes: Welcome everyone. Today I'll be presenting our patent disclosure for the Multi-Dimensional OKR Alignment Scoring System, a novel approach to evaluating goal alignment in enterprise environments.

slides.title: Problem Statement

bullets: Existing OKR systems use simplistic alignment checks: keyword matching or single-dimensional similarity
Real organisational alignment requires matching against multiple targets: strategy documents, supervisor objectives, and methodology best practices
Current RAG systems retrieve documents without organisational awareness — treating team, department, and company documents equally
Alignment scores are opaque with no actionable feedback for improvement

slides.speaker_notes: The core problem is that existing solutions are too simplistic. They miss the multi-faceted nature of real organisational alignment. An employee's objective needs to align with their team's strategy more than company-wide initiatives, but current systems can't express this.

slides.title: Technical Solution

content.description: A three-dimensional alignment scoring system with scope-aware document retrieval and dynamic hierarchy traversal.
bullets: Strategic Alignment (40%): Scope-weighted document similarity (team 1.2x, dept 1.0x, company 0.8x)
Vertical Alignment (40%): Parent objective or supervisor OKR matching with up to 3-level hierarchy traversal
Quality Alignment (20%): Methodology compliance with bilingual measurability detection
Transparent score breakdown with actionable suggestions

slides.speaker_notes: Our solution introduces three independent scoring dimensions that are combined into a composite score. The key innovations are scope-aware weighting and dynamic hierarchy traversal. If a user's direct manager has no OKRs, we automatically look up the management chain.

slides.title: System Architecture

content.diagram_description: Three parallel scoring engines feed into a composite calculator, with a scope-aware retrieval module providing context

slides.speaker_notes: This diagram shows how the three scoring engines work in parallel. Note the scope-aware retrieval module that weights documents based on organisational proximity. The composite calculator applies configurable weights and handles cases where some dimensions are unavailable.

slides.title: Key Features

bullets: Scope-aware document weighting: Team 1.2x > Dept 1.0x > Company 0.8x
Dynamic hierarchy traversal: Up to 3 levels with circular reference detection
Bilingual support: CJK detection for Chinese OKRs (>30% threshold)
Proportional normalisation: Weights adjust when dimensions unavailable
Embedding cache: LRU cache (256 entries) with >60% hit rate
Actionable output: Per-dimension breakdown + improvement suggestions

slides.speaker_notes: Let me highlight the key technical features. The scope-aware weighting is particularly novel — no existing RAG system considers organisational proximity. The bilingual support uses CJK character frequency detection to switch between English and Chinese patterns.

slides.title: Patent Claims Summary

claims_summary: Claim 1 (Independent): Computer-implemented method for multi-dimensional goal alignment with scope-aware weighting, dynamic hierarchy traversal, and proportional normalisation
Claim 2: Specific scope weights (team 1.2, dept 1.0, company 0.8) with score capping
Claim 3: Circular reference detection in management chain traversal
Claim 4: Bilingual measurability detection with 30% CJK threshold
Claim 5: LRU embedding cache for performance optimisation
Claim 6: Structured output with breakdown, warnings, and suggestions

slides.speaker_notes: The independent claim covers our core innovation: the combination of three-dimensional scoring with scope-aware weighting and dynamic traversal. The dependent claims protect specific implementation details that differentiate us from any prior art.

slides.title: Summary & Next Steps

content.closing_message: This invention provides a novel approach to OKR alignment scoring that is more accurate, transparent, and actionable than existing solutions.

slides.speaker_notes: In summary, our multi-dimensional approach with scope-aware weighting represents a significant advancement over existing single-dimensional solutions. The next step is formal review with patent counsel to refine the claims before filing.

presentation_tips: Emphasize the novelty of scope-aware weighting — this is the key differentiator
Be prepared to explain why three dimensions vs. one is non-obvious
Have specific examples ready for the bilingual support feature
Know the cache hit rate statistic (>60%) for performance questions

anticipated_questions.question: How is this different from standard RAG?
anticipated_questions.suggested_answer: Standard RAG treats all documents equally. Our system weights documents based on organisational proximity — team documents are more relevant than company-wide documents for most employees.

anticipated_questions.question: Why three dimensions specifically?
anticipated_questions.suggested_answer: Each dimension captures a different aspect of alignment: strategic direction, management hierarchy, and methodology compliance. Existing systems only use one dimension, typically parent-child matching.

anticipated_questions.question: Is the 30% CJK threshold arbitrary?
anticipated_questions.suggested_answer: The threshold was empirically determined through testing with bilingual content. Below 30%, text is typically English with occasional Chinese names. Above 30%, the content is meaningfully Chinese and requires Chinese-specific patterns.
